reminders.buttonsLocked: The Confirm, Reschedule and Cancel buttons are not part of your plan.

timeline.label: Reminder timeline
timeline.count: {count} of {max} steps with a time. The booking confirmation and the no-show message do not count.
timeline.capReached: You have reached {max} steps with a time. Remove one to add another.
timeline.rebookLocked: Rebook messages are not part of your plan. You can set the step up, but it stays off until you upgrade.
timeline.rebookLockedStep: This step cannot be switched on with your current plan.
timeline.empty: No steps yet. Add the first step, or start from a ready-made sequence.

laneHint.booked: Sent as soon as the booking is made.
laneHint.before: Sent before the appointment starts, never after it.
laneHint.after: Sent after the appointment ends, or when it is marked as a no-show.

stepHint.confirmation: Sent right after the booking is confirmed.
stepHint.reminder_24h: The day before. It can carry the Confirm, Reschedule and Cancel buttons.
stepHint.reminder_2h: A short reminder a couple of hours before.
stepHint.reminder_15m: For online appointments with a join link only.
stepHint.reminder: A reminder at a time you choose.
stepHint.after_visit: A thank-you or follow-up after the appointment ends.
stepHint.no_show: Sent when you mark the appointment as a no-show.
stepHint.rebook: Asks the contact to book again some days after a completed appointment. Counts as marketing.

choiceHint.locked: Plan upgrade needed to switch on

fallback.email: Until the WhatsApp template is approved, this step goes out by email.
fallback.window: WhatsApp is the only channel here, so outside the 24 hour window nothing is sent until a template is approved. Add email as a fallback.

reasons.no_join_link: The appointment has no join link.
reasons.plan_feature_locked: Your plan does not include this step.
reasons.not_delivered: WhatsApp did not deliver it in time, so the next channel was used.
reasons.send_failed: The send failed, so the next channel was used.

packs.title: Ready-made reminder sequences
packs.intro: Pick a sequence for your kind of business. It sets up the confirmation, the reminders, the follow-up and the rebook message in one go. WhatsApp messages need Meta's approval before they can be sent; until then each step goes out by email.
packs.machineDraft: The Hindi text is a machine-made draft. Have someone who reads Hindi check it before you switch the steps on.
packs.summary: {add} to add, {replace} to replace, {unchanged} already the same
packs.blocked: Applying this sequence would pass the limit of {max} steps with a time. Remove a step first.
packs.confirmTitle: This replaces steps you already have
packs.confirmBody: {count, plural, one {# step of this booking type} other {# steps of this booking type}} will be replaced by the sequence's version, including any text you wrote.
packs.replaceOwnText: You wrote your own text for this step. It will be replaced.

planNotes.rebook: Your plan does not include rebook messages, so this step is saved switched off.
planNotes.buttons: Your plan does not include the reply buttons, so they are left out.

packs.kept: {count, plural, one {# step you already have is not touched.} other {# steps you already have are not touched.}}

sample.title: Sample values
sample.hint: The messages are shown with these made-up values. Change them to see how a longer name or another place reads.

packs.submitToMeta: Send the WhatsApp messages to Meta for approval now
packs.submitHint: {count, plural, one {# new WhatsApp message is created.} other {# new WhatsApp messages are created.}} Meta decides when to approve; until then the step goes out by email. Leave this off to keep them as drafts.
packs.submitHintNone: The WhatsApp messages already exist in your workspace, so nothing new is created.

block.readOnly: You can look at the sequences but not apply them.
block.unsaved: Save or discard your changes to this booking type's steps first.
block.cap: Remove a step first: the limit of steps with a time would be passed.

errors.needsConfirm: Applying would replace a step, so it needs your confirmation. The preview has been reloaded.
errors.cap: The sequence would pass the limit of steps with a time for this booking type.

result.title: The sequence is applied
result.summary: {added} added, {replaced} replaced. The steps start as the sequence sets them.
result.templatesNone: No WhatsApp message was created. Connect a WhatsApp Cloud API number to use WhatsApp; email is used meanwhile.
result.waiting: Until Meta approves a message, that step goes out by email.
